phone.note: Attach phone.glb to the character's socket_phone_R node with an identity transform (phone.position.set(0,0,0); phone.quaternion.identity(); socket.add(phone)). The phone's long axis is +Y and its screen faces +Z; in phone_call the screen faces the ear, in selfie it faces the character's face.

style: A: low-poly, flat-shaded (vertex colours, no textures)
material: one material 'lowpoly' per file, baseColor from COLOR_0 vertex colours, no normals exported (GLTFLoader turns on flatShading), backface culling on
clips_note: all clips are in place (no root motion) and loop; move the root at speeds.walk / speeds.run m/s to avoid foot sliding. sit/drive_sit lower the hips: place the model so its 'hip' point (glTF coords, model space) lands on the seat / car seatHip.
morphs_note: smile, deadpan, what (open-mouth 'WHAT?!'), blink, talk (mouth half open), nervous (teeth-clenched grimace, worried brows), smug (one-sided smirk, one brow up) on mesh 'head'
sockets_note: socket_hand_R is oriented so an upright prop (+Y up) stands upright in the drink clip's hold pose; socket_phone_R holds props.phone (see props.phone.note); socket_hand_L is axis-aligned at rest; socket_head sits at the crown.
clip_placement_note: sit / type_seated / sleep_seated: put the model's 'hip' (glTF, model space) on the seat's hip point. type: stands at a counter of type.counterHeight; type_seated: desk surface at type_seated.deskHeight. drive_sit: 'hip' on the car seatHip; hands on wheelCenter.
